","t10s03l01_de":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","t10s03l01_sr":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","t10s03l02_de":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","t10s03l02_sr":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","t10s03l03_de":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","t10s03l03_sr":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","t10s04l00_de":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","t10s04l00_sr":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","t10s04l01_de":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","t10s04l01_sr":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","t10s04l02_de":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","t10s04l02_sr":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","t10s05l00_de":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","t10s05l00_sr":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","t10s05l01_de":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","t10s05l01_sr":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,"}}</script>
<script>
'use strict';
const TOPICS=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('topicData').textContent);
const HELP=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('helpData').textContent);
const ASSETS=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('assetsData').textContent);
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
let topicIndex=Math.max(0,Math.min(TOPICS.length-1,parseInt(localStorage.getItem('demaxA2Topic')||'0')||0));
let activeTab='dialog',activeSection='all',showTranslation=localStorage.getItem('demaxA2HideSr')!=='yes';
let marked=new Set(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('demaxA2Marked')||'[]'));
let practiceRole='B',practiceIndex=0,revealed=false,micText='',micScore=null;
let playToken=0,playingAudio=null,recognized=null,voiceMode=localStorage.getItem('demaxA2VoiceMode')||'auto';
let currentlyPlayingId=null;
let isPlaying=false;
const getAllLines=(t)=>t.sections.flatMap(s=>s.lines);
const getVisibleLines=()=>TOPICS[topicIndex].sections.filter((s,i)=>activeSection==='all'||i===activeSection).flatMap(s=>s.lines);
const getById=(id)=>TOPICS.flatMap(t=>t.sections.flatMap(s=>s.lines)).concat(HELP).find(x=>x.id===id);
const topicImg=(i)=>ASSETS.images[i];
const clipSrc=(id,lang)=>ASSETS.audioPrefix ? ASSETS.audioPrefix+id+'_'+lang+'.mp3' : ASSETS.audio[id+'_'+lang];
const storeMarks=()=>localStorage.setItem('demaxA2Marked',JSON.stringify([...marked]));
function listTopics(query=''){
 const q=query.toLocaleLowerCase();$('#topicList').innerHTML=TOPICS.map((t,i)=>({t,i})).filter(({t})=>(t.title+' '+t.sr).toLocaleLowerCase().includes(q)).map(({t,i})=>`<button class="topicBtn ${i===topicIndex?'active':''}" data-topic="${i}"><span class="topicNum">${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')}</span><span><span class="topicLabel">${esc(t.emoji)} ${esc(t.title)}</span><span class="topicSr">${esc(t.sr)}</span></span></button>`).join('')||'<p class="empty">Nema pronađenih tema.</p>';
 $('#topicList').querySelectorAll('[data-topic]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>selectTopic(+b.dataset.topic)));
 $('#mobileTopics').innerHTML=TOPICS.map((t,i)=>`<option value="${i}" ${i===topicIndex?'selected':''}>${i+1}. ${esc(t.title)}</option>`).join('');
}
function selectTopic(i){stop();topicIndex=(i+TOPICS.length)%TOPICS.length;localStorage.setItem('demaxA2Topic',topicIndex);activeSection='all';practiceIndex=0;revealed=false;micText='';micScore=null;render();}
function setTab(t){stop();activeTab=t;activeSection='all';practiceIndex=0;revealed=false;micText='';micScore=null;render();}
function setStatus(txt){$('#audioStatus').textContent=txt;}
function lineCard(l){return `<article class="bubble ${l.role==='B'?'roleB':''}" id="line-${l.id}"><div class="bubbleMark">${l.role}</div><div class="bubbleBody"><div class="deSentence">${esc(l.de)}</div>${showTranslation?`<div class="srSentence">${esc(l.sr)}</div>`:''}<div class="bubbleActions"><button class="speakBtn" data-say="${l.id}:de">🔊 DE</button><button class="speakBtn sr" data-say="${l.id}:sr">🔊 SR</button><button class="speakBtn both" data-say="${l.id}:both">▶ DE + SR</button><button class="starBtn ${marked.has(l.id)?'marked':''}" data-star="${l.id}" title="Sačuvaj u moj izbor">${marked.has(l.id)?'★ Sačuvano':'☆ Sačuvaj'}</button></div></div></article>`}
function sourcePanel(){const t=TOPICS[topicIndex];return `<aside class="sourcePanel"><div class="panelTop">📄 ORIGINALNA ISPITNA POSTAVKA <button data-open-source="1">⤢ Uvećaj</button></div><div class="sourceScroll"><img class="sourceImage" src="${topicImg(topicIndex)}" data-open-source="1" alt="Ispitna postavka, stranica ${t.page}"><div class="sourceHint">Klikni na sliku za uvećanje · Strana ${t.page}/10</div><div class="sectionMenu"><button class="chip ${activeSection==='all'?'active':''}" data-section="all">Sve rečenice</button>${t.sections.map((s,i)=>`<button class="chip ${i===activeSection?'active':''}" data-section="${i}">${esc(s.title)}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="introBox"><strong>🎯 Zadatak na ispitu</strong><div>Razgovarajte sa partnerom, predložite ideje, pitajte za mišljenje, dogovorite detalje i na kraju potvrdite zajednički plan.</div></div></div></aside>`}
function renderDialog(){const t=TOPICS[topicIndex];let body=t.sections.map((s,i)=>activeSection!=='all' && i!==activeSection?'':`<section class="dialogSec"><div class="sectionTitle"><div><strong>${esc(s.title)}</strong><small>${esc(s.sub)}</small></div></div>${s.lines.map(lineCard).join('')}</section>`).join('');
 $('#content').innerHTML=`<div class="dialogLayout">${sourcePanel()}<div class="mainPanel"><div class="panelTop"><span>💬 MOGUĆI DIJALOG · KANDIDAT A + B</span><button class="mobileSourceBtn" data-open-source="1">📄 Postavka</button><span style="font-size:11px;color:#9aa5b5">${getVisibleLines().length} rečenica</span></div><div class="mainList">${body}</div></div></div>`;
 $('#content').querySelectorAll('[data-section]').forEach(e=>e.addEventListener('click',()=>{activeSection=e.dataset.section==='all'?'all':+e.dataset.section;renderDialog()}));
 $('#content').querySelectorAll('[data-open-source]').forEach(e=>e.addEventListener('click',openSource));
 attachLineControls($('#content'));
}
function attachLineControls(root){root.querySelectorAll('[data-say]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{let [id,lg]=b.dataset.say.split(':');const v=getById(id);if(!v)return;playItems(lg==='both'?[{...v,lang:'de'},{...v,lang:'sr'}]:[{...v,lang:lg}]);}));root.querySelectorAll('[data-star]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{const id=b.dataset.star;marked.has(id)?marked.delete(id):marked.add(id);storeMarks();if(activeTab==='saved')renderSaved();else{b.classList.toggle('marked');b.textContent=marked.has(id)?'★ Sačuvano':'☆ Sačuvaj';}}));}
function practiceQueue(){return getAllLines(TOPICS[topicIndex]).map((l,i)=>({...l,idx:i})).filter(l=>l.role===practiceRole)}
function renderPractice(){const t=TOPICS[topicIndex],all=getAllLines(t),queue=practiceQueue();practiceIndex=Math.max(0,Math.min(queue.length-1,practiceIndex));let answer=queue[practiceIndex];let previous=all.slice(0,answer.idx).reverse().find(l=>l.role!==practiceRole);let progress=(practiceIndex+1)/queue.length*100;
 $('#content').innerHTML=`<div class="pageContainer"><h2 class="pageHead">🎙 Vežbaj dijalog kao kandidat ${practiceRole}</h2><p class="pageSub">Slušaj rečenicu partnera, odgovori naglas na nemačkom i tek onda otkrij predloženi odgovor. Izaberi da li si kandidat A ili B.</p><div class="practiceControls"><div class="roleSelect"><button class="${practiceRole==='A'?'active':''}" data-role="A">Ja sam A</button><button class="${practiceRole==='B'?'active':''}" data-role="B">Ja sam B</button></div><div class="counter">Rečenica ${practiceIndex+1} od ${queue.length}</div></div><div class="meter"><div style="width:${progress}%"></div></div><div class="practiceCard"><div class="partnerBox"><div class="practiceLabel">👤 PARTNER ${practiceRole==='A'?'B':'A'} KAŽE</div>${previous?`<p>${esc(previous.de)}</p>${showTranslation?`<div class="srSentence">${esc(previous.sr)}</div>`:''}<button class="speakBtn" id="listenPartner">🔊 Slušaj partnera na nemačkom</button>`:`<p>Počni razgovor svojim predlogom.</p><div class="srSentence">Započni temu i reci prvu rečenicu naglas.</div>`}</div><div class="answerBox ${!revealed?'hiddenAnswer':''}">${revealed?`<div class="practiceLabel">✅ MOGUĆI ODGOVOR · KANDIDAT ${practiceRole}</div><p>${esc(answer.de)}</p>${showTranslation?`<div class="srSentence">${esc(answer.sr)}</div>`:''}<button class="speakBtn" id="listenAnswer">🔊 Slušaj DE</button> <button class="speakBtn sr" id="listenAnswerSr">🔊 Slušaj SR</button>`:`<div><p>🎤 Tvoj red! Izgovori odgovor na nemačkom.</p><small>Predloži ideju, odgovori na pitanje ili potvrdi dogovor.</small></div>`}</div><div class="practiceButtons"><button class="stopBtn" id="practicePrev" ${practiceIndex===0?'disabled':''}>‹ Prethodna</button><button class="secondaryBtn" id="micBtn">🎙 Izgovori</button><button class="secondaryBtn" id="revealBtn">${revealed?'🙈 Sakrij':'👁 Prikaži odgovor'}</button><button class="primaryBtn" id="practiceNext">${practiceIndex===queue.length-1?'↻ Ponovi vežbu':'Sledeća ›'}</button></div>${micText?`<div class="micResult"><strong>Prepoznati govor:</strong> ${esc(micText)}${micScore===null?'':`<div>Poklapanje reči sa primerom: <strong>${micScore}%</strong> (nije zvanična procena izgovora)</div>`}</div>`:''}<div class="footerNote">Ovo su predloženi odgovori. Na ispitu možete dati i drugačiji gramatički ispravan odgovor.</div></div></div>`;
 $('#content').querySelectorAll('[data-role]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>{practiceRole=el.dataset.role;practiceIndex=0;revealed=false;micText='';micScore=null;renderPractice()});
 const el=(id,fn)=>{if($('#'+id))$('#'+id).onclick=fn};
 el('listenPartner',()=>playItems([{...previous,lang:'de'}]));el('listenAnswer',()=>playItems([{...answer,lang:'de'}]));el('listenAnswerSr',()=>playItems([{...answer,lang:'sr'}]));
 el('revealBtn',()=>{revealed=!revealed;renderPractice()});
 el('practicePrev',()=>{practiceIndex=Math.max(0,practiceIndex-1);revealed=false;micText='';micScore=null;renderPractice()});
 el('practiceNext',()=>{practiceIndex=(practiceIndex+1)%queue.length;revealed=false;micText='';micScore=null;renderPractice()});
 el('micBtn',()=>startMic(answer));
}
function renderPhrases(){$('#content').innerHTML=`<div class="pageContainer"><h2 class="pageHead">📖 Korisne A2 rečenice</h2><p class="pageSub">Ove fraze možeš upotrebiti u gotovo svim temama kada želiš da predložiš ideju, odgovoriš, složiš se ili se dogovoriš.</p><div class="phraseGrid">${HELP.map(l=>`<div class="phrase"><div class="deSentence">${esc(l.de)}</div>${showTranslation?`<div class="srSentence">${esc(l.sr)}</div>`:''}<div class="bubbleActions"><button class="speakBtn" data-say="${l.id}:de">🔊 DE</button><button class="speakBtn sr" data-say="${l.id}:sr">🔊 SR</button><button class="starBtn ${marked.has(l.id)?'marked':''}" data-star="${l.id}">${marked.has(l.id)?'★':'☆'} Sačuvaj</button></div></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`;attachLineControls($('#content'))}
function renderSaved(){let all=TOPICS.flatMap(t=>t.sections.flatMap(s=>s.lines)).concat(HELP);let selected=all.filter(l=>marked.has(l.id));$('#content').innerHTML=`<div class="pageContainer"><h2 class="pageHead">⭐ Moj izbor rečenica</h2><p class="pageSub">Sačuvane rečenice ostaju u ovom pregledaču. Klikni na zvezdicu uz bilo koju rečenicu da je dodaš ili ukloniš. Možeš da ih slušaš i odštampaš.</p><div style="display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 17px"><button class="secondaryBtn" id="printSaved">⎙ Štampaj svoj izbor</button><button class="stopBtn" id="clearSaved" ${selected.length===0?'disabled':''}>Obriši izbor</button></div>${selected.length?`<div class="savedCards">${selected.map(l=>`<div class="savedItem"><div class="savedHeading">${l.id.startsWith('h')?'KORISNA FRAZA':TOPICS[+l.id.slice(1,3)-1].title}</div><div class="deSentence">${esc(l.de)}</div>${showTranslation?`<div class="srSentence">${esc(l.sr)}</div>`:''}<div class="bubbleActions"><button class="speakBtn" data-say="${l.id}:de">🔊 DE</button><button class="speakBtn sr" data-say="${l.id}:sr">🔊 SR</button><button class="starBtn marked" data-star="${l.id}">★ Ukloni</button></div></div>`).join('')}</div>`:`<div class="empty"><strong>Još nema sačuvanih rečenica</strong>Otvori dijalog ili korisne fraze i klikni ☆ Sačuvaj.</div>`}</div>`;attachLineControls($('#content'));$('#printSaved').onclick=()=>window.print();$('#clearSaved').onclick=()=>{if(confirm('Obrisati sve sačuvane rečenice?')){marked.clear();storeMarks();renderSaved()}}}
function render(){let t=TOPICS[topicIndex];$('#topicTitle').textContent=t.emoji+' '+t.title;$('#topicSubtitle').textContent=t.sr+' · PDF strana '+t.page+' / 10';$('#mobileTopics').value=topicIndex;$('#bottomLabel').textContent=t.title;$('#showSr').checked=showTranslation;document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.tab===activeTab));listTopics($('#topicSearch').value);if(activeTab==='dialog')renderDialog();else if(activeTab==='practice')renderPractice();else if(activeTab==='phrases')renderPhrases();else renderSaved();}
function stop(){++playToken;isPlaying=false;currentlyPlayingId=null;if(window.speechSynthesis)try{speechSynthesis.cancel()}catch(e){}if(playingAudio){playingAudio.pause();playingAudio.currentTime=0;playingAudio=null}if(recognized){try{recognized.stop()}catch(e){}recognized=null}setStatus('Spremno za slušanje')}
function voicesFor(lang){const list=(window.speechSynthesis&&speechSynthesis.getVoices())||[];if(lang==='de')return list.filter(v=>/^de\b|^de[-_]/i.test(v.lang));return list.filter(v=>/^sr\b|^sr[-_]/i.test(v.lang));}
function systemVoice(lang,role='A'){let voices=voicesFor(lang);if(!voices.length)return null;const preferred=lang==='de'? voices.sort((a,b)=>(/de-de|de-at/i.test(b.lang)?1:0)-(/de-de|de-at/i.test(a.lang)?1:0)):voices;return role==='B'&&preferred.length>1?preferred[1]:preferred[0];}
function audioFallback(id,lang,token){return new Promise(resolve=>{if(token!==playToken){resolve();return}let src=clipSrc(id,lang);if(!src){resolve();return}let aud=new Audio(src);playingAudio=aud;aud.playbackRate=parseFloat($('#speed').value);let done=false;const end=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;if(playingAudio===aud)playingAudio=null;resolve()};aud.onended=end;aud.onerror=end;aud.play().catch(end);});}
function speakOne(item,token){if(token!==playToken)return Promise.resolve();let voice=voiceMode==='offline'?null:systemVoice(item.lang,item.role);if(voice&&window.speechSynthesis){return new Promise(resolve=>{let done=false;const finish=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;resolve()};let u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(item[item.lang]);u.voice=voice;u.lang=voice.lang;u.rate=parseFloat($('#speed').value)*(item.lang==='sr'?.92:.94);u.pitch=item.role==='A'?1.04:.97;u.volume=1;u.onend=finish;u.onerror=()=>{if(token!==playToken){finish();return}audioFallback(item.id,item.lang,token).then(finish)};try{speechSynthesis.speak(u)}catch(e){audioFallback(item.id,item.lang,token).then(finish)}})}return audioFallback(item.id,item.lang,token)}
async function playItems(items){stop();if(!items.length)return;let token=playToken;isPlaying=true;for(let i=0;i<items.length;i++){if(token!==playToken)return;let v=items[i];setStatus('🔊 '+(v.lang==='de'?'Nemački':'Srpski')+' · '+(i+1)+' / '+items.length);currentlyPlayingId=v.id;let row=$('#line-'+v.id);if(row){row.style.outline='2px solid #f5ac62';if(items.length>3)row.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest',behavior:'smooth'})}await speakOne(v,token);if(row)row.style.outline='';}if(token===playToken){isPlaying=false;setStatus('Preslušavanje završeno ✓')}}
function sequence(bilingual){let list=activeTab==='dialog'?getVisibleLines():activeTab==='phrases'?HELP:activeTab==='saved'?TOPICS.flatMap(t=>t.sections.flatMap(s=>s.lines)).concat(HELP).filter(l=>marked.has(l.id)):getAllLines(TOPICS[topicIndex]);return list.flatMap(l=>bilingual?[{...l,lang:'de'},{...l,lang:'sr'}]:[{...l,lang:'de'}])}
function openSource(){const t=TOPICS[topicIndex];showModal('📄 '+t.title,`<img class="modalImage" src="${topicImg(topicIndex)}" alt="Originalna ispitna tema"><div class="note">Ovo je originalna ispitna postavka iz priloženog PDF-a, strana ${t.page}. Dijalozi i prevodi u aplikaciji su dodatni nastavni primeri.</div>`)}
function showModal(title,html){$('#modalTitle').textContent=title;$('#modalContent').innerHTML=html;$('#overlay').classList.remove('hidden')}
function closeModal(){$('#overlay').classList.add('hidden');$('#modalContent').innerHTML=''}
function settings(){let de=voicesFor('de'),sr=voicesFor('sr');showModal('⚙ Podešavanja izgovora',`<div class="settingsGrid"><div class="settingCell"><label for="voiceMode">Izvor zvuka</label><select id="voiceMode"><option value="auto" ${voiceMode==='auto'?'selected':''}>Glas uređaja (ako postoji), pa ugrađeni</option><option value="offline" ${voiceMode==='offline'?'selected':''}>Ugrađeni zvuk (radi bez interneta)</option></select></div><div class="settingCell"><label for="modalSpeed">Brzina izgovora</label><select id="modalSpeed"><option value="0.78">Sporije 0,78×</option><option value="0.9">Sporije 0,9×</option><option value="1">Normalno 1×</option><option value="1.12">Brže 1,12×</option></select></div></div><div class="note"><strong>🔈 Nemački glas:</strong> ${de.length?esc(de[0].name):'koristi se ugrađeni snimak'}<br><strong>🔈 Srpski glas:</strong> ${sr.length?esc(sr[0].name):'koristi se ugrađeni srpski snimak'}<br><br>Aplikacija sadrži posebne nemačke i srpske snimke za svaku rečenicu. Ugrađeni snimci su sintetički (računarski) glas. Ako vaš uređaj ima prirodniji glas za nemački ili srpski, aplikacija će ga koristiti u automatskom režimu.</div><button class="secondaryBtn" id="testSound">▶ Proveri nemački i srpski zvuk</button>`);$('#voiceMode').onchange=e=>{voiceMode=e.target.value;localStorage.setItem('demaxA2VoiceMode',voiceMode)};$('#modalSpeed').value=$('#speed').value;$('#modalSpeed').onchange=e=>$('#speed').value=e.target.value;$('#testSound').onclick=()=>playItems([{id:'h03',de:HELP[3].de,sr:HELP[3].sr,role:'A',lang:'de'},{id:'h03',de:HELP[3].de,sr:HELP[3].sr,role:'A',lang:'sr'}]);}
function normalize(x){return x.toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').replace(/[^a-zäöüß ]/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()}
function startMic(expected){const SR=window.SpeechRecognition||window.webkitSpeechRecognition;if(!SR){micText='Prepoznavanje govora nije podržano. Probaj Chrome ili Edge sa dozvoljenim mikrofonom.';micScore=null;renderPractice();return}stop();const r=new SR();recognized=r;r.lang='de-DE';r.continuous=false;r.interimResults=false;setStatus('🎙 Slušam nemački govor…');r.onresult=e=>{const got=e.results[0][0].transcript;let a=normalize(got).split(' ').filter(Boolean),b=normalize(expected.de).split(' ').filter(Boolean),tmp=[...b],hit=0;for(const word of a){let i=tmp.indexOf(word);if(i>=0){hit++;tmp.splice(i,1)}}micScore=Math.min(100,Math.round(200*hit/(a.length+b.length||1)));micText=got;recognized=null;renderPractice();setStatus('Prepoznati tekst, ne ocena izgovora')};r.onerror=e=>{micText='Mikrofon nije dostupan ('+e.error+'). Proveri dozvole pregledača.';micScore=null;recognized=null;renderPractice()};r.onend=()=>{recognized=null};try{r.start()}catch(e){micText='Mikrofon nije dostupan. '+e.message;recognized=null;renderPractice()}}
$('#topicSearch').addEventListener('input',e=>listTopics(e.target.value));$('#mobileTopics').addEventListener('change',e=>selectTopic(+e.target.value));$('#prevTopic').onclick=()=>selectTopic(topicIndex-1);$('#nextTopic').onclick=()=>selectTopic(topicIndex+1);document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>setTab(el.dataset.tab));$('#showSr').onchange=e=>{showTranslation=e.target.checked;localStorage.setItem('demaxA2HideSr',showTranslation?'no':'yes');render()};$('#playDe').onclick=()=>playItems(sequence(false));$('#playBoth').onclick=()=>playItems(sequence(true));$('#stopAudio').onclick=stop;$('#printBtn').onclick=()=>window.print();$('#settingsBtn').onclick=settings;$('#closeModal').onclick=closeModal;$('#overlay').addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.id==='overlay')closeModal()});window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){stop();closeModal()}});window.addEventListener('beforeunload',stop);

if(window.speechSynthesis){speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged=()=>{};speechSynthesis.getVoices()}
render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
